# SPR: the Sealed Payment Record

> An open format, with free libraries and an MCP server, for recording each payment an AI agent makes: what it declared before paying, what settled and on which rail, sealed with the company's own key on its own machine, and checkable by anyone without trusting a service. Apache-2.0, with a royalty-free patent commitment.

Use SPR when an agent pays for something (x402, Stripe, cards or other rails) and someone needs a record they can check later: finance, an auditor, the counterparty.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/README.md): what SPR does and how to run it from Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and agent frameworks
- [MCP server](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/packages/spr-mcp/README.md): `npx -y @luca-network/spr-mcp`, its tools and settings
- [JavaScript SDK](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/packages/spr-sdk/README.md): `@luca-network/spr-sdk`, including `withLuca(fetch)` for x402
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/python/README.md): `pip install spr-sdk`
- [Examples](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/tree/main/examples): CrewAI, Microsoft Agent Framework, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK

## Tools an agent calls

- `record_intent`: call first, just before paying, with the purpose and the most it may pay (amounts in minor units: cents, or 6 decimals for USDC)
- `check_payment`: call before paying; if it declines, do not pay
- `record_settlement`: call after paying, with the rail's own reference and the time it settled
- `cancel_intent`: withdraw an intent that will not be paid
- `get_intent`, `verify_record`, `list_records`, `export_package`: read and check the book

## Format

- [Specification](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/SPEC.md): draft 1
- [Test vectors](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/packages/spr/vectors/vectors.json): an implementation conforms when it gives the same answers
- [Governance](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md), [maintainers](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md) and [patent commitment](https://github.com/luca-network/spr/blob/main/PATENTS.md)
